column7: The collection of scriptures we have today reflects the written words of God. God, by His Spirit, inspired select men and revealed to them His words. In the earliest period, before Moses, not much was formally written down; instead, oral tradition preserved much of God's interactions with humanity over centuries. The scriptures state that God used Moses to write the Torah (the first five books of the Old Testament), marking the beginning of a more formal written record of God's instructions and covenant with His people.
